Name: Witch's Garden Flowers for Custom Furniture
Author: Squiver
Description:
A mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]!

Be sure to download Custom Furniture Anywhere if you want to be able to place these flowers outside.

To install, simply unpack the file into your Stardew Valley Mods folder!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Adds a few decorative herbs modeled after real life herbs traditionally associated with magic and witchcraft - both healing and poison herbs - or that otherwise have a witchy aesthetic to them!

Herbs include:
[list]
[*]Yarrow ([i]Achillea millefolium[/i])
[*]Wormwood ([i]Artemisia absinthium[/i])
[*]Belladonna ([i]Atropa belladonna[/i])
[*]Poison Hemlock ([i]Conium maculatum[/i])
[*]Hollyhock ([i]Alcea rosea[/i])
[*]Garden Sage ([i]Salvia officinalis[/i])
[*]Stinging Nettle ([i]Urtica dioica[/i])
[*]Rue ([i]Ruta graveolens[/i])
[*]Borage ([i]Borago officinalis[/i])
[*]German Chamomile ([i]Matricaria chamomilla[/i])
[/list]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Please note! As of now, these herbs are being converted into a custom crop as part of an upcoming comprehensive magic mod! I thank anyone who has reached out to offer to help me convert these into custom crops, but I'm afraid I wouldn't feel right giving out the permission to multiple people. Thank you so much!
